name: Top Gun: Maverick
summary:
Take to the skies with attitude in Top Gun: Maverick by Play Mechanix and Raw Thrills.

Based upon the movie and series of the same name that stars Tom Cruise and Val Kilmer, Top Gun: Maverick puts players into the seat of an American fighter jet, whether that’s the the legendary F-14 Tomcat, F-15E Strike Eagle or the F/A-18 Super Hornet – players get to choose! Command incredible firepower across six harrowing and action-packed missions, becoming the first of your squadron to destroy the main enemy objective. Many targets will be in your way up to that point, where you can use both your machine gun and missiles to take them out. You can also bolster your arsenal thanks to plentiful power-ups that are placed along the way.
